title: Not the same as it was
text: Not the same as it was. I bought this pillow about a year ago and I LOVED it. Memory foam was soft and perfect to bring to concerts and other events for my back. I loved it so much I bought another. Unfortunately, it was NOT the same quality. The memory foam was shredded and the pillow was in 2 chunks. It is horrid and I can't use it. I would like a replacement.
